module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  train_valid,
    input  train_taken,
    output reg [1:0] state
);
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b01;
        else if (train_valid) begin
            if (train_taken) begin
                if (state < 2'b11) state <= state + 1;
            end
            else if (state > 2'b00) state <= state - 1;
        end
    end
endmodule
